about_the_game:
This early version of Axis Shift offers a first look at the upcoming third-person action arcade game where you seamlessly switch between Tank, Spaceship, and Submarine.

WHAT YOU'LL EXPERIENCE

Transformations: Shift instantly between three distinct vehicles – Tank, Spaceship, and Submarine.

Unique Abilities: Explore each form's combat and movement style. Combine them to find your playstyle.

Enemy Variety: Face off against early prototypes of four of our robotic, animal-inspired foes. Can you defeat them all?

Open Battle Arenas: Take on waves of enemies across two handcrafted arenas, facing increasingly challenging encounters.

PLAYER ABILITIES AND WEAPONS

Tank: Cannon, Grappling Hook, Shield

Spaceship: Light Guns, Homing Missiles, Barrel Roll

Submarine: Stun Missile, Sonar Scan

This is just the beginning. Wishlist Axis Shift today and share your feedback to help shape the full experience!
